claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Fermi Inc. 後續申報寫出變壓器交期縮短到 12 個月以內、取消或延後長交期設備採購，或改說電力設備不再是時程瓶頸。核查頻率：每季（Fermi Inc. 10-Q／8-K）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊的 confidence，重讀 LPT 層需求側。
claims.statement: Fermi (FY2025 10-K): in February 2026 entered a $120.0 million high-voltage equipment warehouse financing facility (upsizable by $100.0 million) to support procurement of long-lead electrical infrastructure for Project Matador, including substations, transformers and breakers, enabling advance procurement and staged delivery; risk factors say industry-wide constraints on manufacturing capacity and delivery lead times may delay energization. Transformer type and suppliers are not named.

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR 公開申報；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取 EDGAR 申報日。
source_doc.title: Fermi FY2025 10-K：2026 年 2 月簽 1.2 億美元高壓設備倉儲融資，用來提前採購 Project Matador 的變電站、變壓器、斷路器等長交期設備；風險段寫製造產能與交期全產業受限

sources.locator: Item 1 Business — High Voltage Equipment Warehouse Financing
sources.quote: In February 2026, we entered into a $120.0 million high-voltage equipment warehouse financing facility with Keystone National Group, LLC, which may be increased by up to an additional $100.0 million subject to the terms and conditions of the financing agreement. The facility is intended to support the procurement of long-lead electrical infrastructure required for Project Matador, including substations, transformers, breakers, and related high-voltage switchgear and balance-of-plant equipment. This facility is intended to enhance execution certainty by enabling advance procurement and staged delivery of critical non-spinning equipment necessary to support campus energization and phased power delivery.

sources.locator: Item 1A Risk Factors — Long-Lead Equipment and Key Supplier Concentration
sources.quote: The project requires procurement of long-lead equipment, including turbines, transformers, breakers, substations, and related high-voltage infrastructure. Industry-wide constraints on manufacturing capacity and delivery lead times may delay energization schedules or increase project costs.
